01What does this evidence establish?

Evidence dates differ by domain: several payments and regulatory observations date from 2025–2026, while key representative evidence about people is older. Each item is placed by its observation or publication date and by its evidence type: representative survey, administrative record, regulatory material, secondary evidence or unresolved gap. Newer administrative data are not automatically a current population outcome, and older evidence is not automatically invalid.

06Original source and verification

Evidence records assembled in this view

  • Account ownership: the representative measure from the Global Findex 2021 wave CLM-001
  • Geographic coverage limits of the Global Findex 2021 wave in Yemen CLM-025
  • Historical saving patterns in 2014 CLM-029
  • There is no single latest year for all people-side evidence CLM-031
  • Historical borrowing patterns in 2014 CLM-028
  • Financial-literacy activity does not establish capability outcomes CLM-013
  • Financial literacy — activity is not outcome VIS-FL-EVIDENCE-LADDER
  • Can an adult raise emergency funds — in 7 days versus 30? VIS-FINDEX-RESILIENCE
  • A measured gender gap in account ownership CLM-002
  • Account ownership and measured gaps: Global Findex 2021 wave (Yemen fieldwork 2022–23) VIS-FINDEX-GAPS
  • The FMIIP access-point target is not comparable with ATM, POS or agent counts XW-FMIIP-005
  • Historical provider data show concentration in cities and low female representation CLM-052
  • 807,919 accounts did not mean 807,919 active people CLM-050
  • FMIIP project baselines for January 2025 count accounts, access points, merchants and agents — not people FMIIP-BASELINE-2025-01
  • POS infrastructure expanded CLM-003
  • Latest monthly point-of-sale (POS) release listed by CBY-Aden: June 2026 on its Arabic payments page, January 2026 on its English payments page (both checked 3 October 2026) CLM-017
  • E-money rules set limits; they do not measure use CLM-012
  • A successful cash payment is not yet durable financial use CLM-045
  • Domestic-remittance pathways in 2014 CLM-030
  • IMF remittance series: reported history, estimates and projections kept separate CLM-007
  • Same reference year, different published value CLM-032
  • Quoted cost of sending US$200 and US$500 to Yemen from Saudi Arabia and the UAE, 2025 Q3 VIS-REMITTANCE-COST
  • Listing or licensing does not establish operation CLM-008
  • The official 2026 exchange and remittance roster can be counted; whether providers operate now is a separate question CLM-009
  • Enforcement decisions are events, not a market census CLM-019
  • A dated list of unlicensed services, not a permanent status CLM-015
  • End-2023 borrower evidence is useful, but still secondary CLM-053
  • Borrower, saver and portfolio figures come from different sources and definitions and do not yet form one trend CLM-054
  • A measured banking jump can partly be a valuation change CLM-033
  • The 2023 valuation change has a precedent and cannot be called the “first ever” CLM-038
  • Finance was not the most frequently cited constraint in this survey CLM-005
  • Finance severity within a specific denominator CLM-006
  • Programme reach describes the programmes, not all MSMEs in Yemen CLM-059
  • The SMEPS financial-services KPI is a programme result, not a national MSME rate CLM-060
  • The complaint path is documented; there is no evidence yet on how it performs CLM-011
  • Consumer protection and complaint path: official rules and guidance DS-FCP-ARCH
  • Institution-building steps are not evidence of operation or outcomes CLM-018

07Method and verification detail

Detail for reproducing or challenging this record without changing what it means.

How was it produced?

Evidence is listed by observation or publication date and by evidence type; no freshness score is computed.

When does this record change?

This record is updated when an authoritative source is revised or replaced, a newer comparable observation becomes available, the definition, population or method changes, or the conditions for public use change.

How should this record be read?

Read this evidence within the definition, population or group covered, calculation base where relevant, period, geography and method shown on the page. Before reusing or comparing it, check the source, limitations, evidence date and correction history. If a value or source link is unavailable, the page says so rather than filling the gap by inference. This resource does not host source files; where an original-source link is given, check the publisher’s terms before republishing.
